messages:
Marco: Unbelievable 90+4' penalty save. I actually jumped out of my chair 😂 :soccer: anyone else still buzzing?
Tess: I screamed so loud the dog barked. that save was cinematic. who recorded it?
Aisha: @Lee grabbed the stream — he had the inflatable horn. can we do a victory potluck tomorrow? i'm bringing empanadas.
Lee: I did! clip is here: https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ (just kidding, real clip in #eng-releases). i'll bring chips and a salad.
OpsBot: Poll created by Marco: "Victory potluck tomorrow?" — React with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no, :shrug: for maybe.
Tess: Quick fantasy update: that save just flipped my mini-league. Marco you owe me a celebratory beer :beer: (and a point in the pool)
Marco: Haha deal. also thinking of a $5 office pool for the away leg next week — sign up on the sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheetsexample
Aisha: Added myself to the sheet and the potluck column (empanadas). @Lee put me down as spicy pls.
Lee: gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/soccer-save-tada — mood. see y'all tomorrow at 6pm in the kitchen.
OpsBot: Poll results: :thumbsup: 6, :thumbsdown: 1, :shrug: 2. Victory potluck confirmed.
Tess: Shoutout to @Marco for organizing the stream — smooth as always :clap:
Marco: Thanks! see everyone tomorrow. bring napkins. :tada:
